name: FlickeringGrid
description: A grid of small squares that gently fade in and out, drawn on a canvas that fills its parent.

squareSize.description: Side of each square in pixels.

color.description: Colour of the squares: any CSS colour or token.

maxOpacity.description: Brightest a square gets, from 0 to 1.

isStill.description: Stops all movement. Moving content should be stoppable.

requirements: Pure decoration: aria-hidden, never focusable, and pointer-events none so content on top stays usable
Drawn on a canvas, so it adds no DOM nodes and is safe in server HTML
Each square changes at most about 2 times a second and fades over most of a second, never a hard flash
Stands still for visitors who ask for less motion (prefers-reduced-motion), with isStill, and inside an rdm-still container
Nothing flashes more than 3 times a second (WCAG 2.3.1) and moving content can be stopped (WCAG 2.2.2)
Hidden in forced-colors (high contrast) mode so it never fights system colours
Keep text on top at 4.5:1 against the effect: use a low-contrast colour

use_when: A quiet living texture behind a hero or empty state
avoid_when: On pages with several other moving effects
anti_patterns: A bright colour or a high maxOpacity that makes the squares compete with content
Several flickering grids on one screen
